description: Over 4,000 problem pages archive Kevin Huang's LeetCode solutions in six languages, alongside thirteen data structure implementations. Search runs from a JSON index reachable with a slash shortcut, and per-difficulty progress bars sit beside an upcoming events list scraped from Meetup at build time. Two custom content loaders read the raw source files, one parsing a numbered header comment into an id and title, the other using the filename.
name: Aephonics - Algo
